messages:
zoe: PR #518 (guides/migration/component-props) failed docs CI on preview. linkcheck + vale + markdownlint. preview: https://staging-docs/redwood/pr/518
alejandro: paste the failing lines?
zoe: linkcheck:
```
Broken anchor: /api/components#props-parsing -> 404 Not Found
```
vale:
```
ProseUse: avoid 'utilise' -> prefer 'use' at line 34
Tone: 'should' flagged in an imperative sentence at line 12
```
markdownlint:
```
MD013 line-length: code fence line 9 exceeds 120 chars
```
mei: anchor id changed in the components refactor. correct target is /api/components#property-parsing. I can update the link and fix the wording.
alejandro: i can handle the markdownlint wrapping in the example code block. Will replace long inline JSON with a compact placeholder and move full JSON to a fenced block.
zoe: thanks both. I'm going to push two tiny commits: anchor fix + wording change, and the code block reflow.
ci-bot: build started for PR #518 (docs-preview + linkcheck + vale + markdownlint)
alejandro: pushed commit 1782700102 - wrapped code, added separate fenced JSON, preserved syntax highlighting
mei: pushed commit 1782700110 - updated anchor to `/api/components#property-parsing` and changed 'utilise' -> 'use'; rephrased 'should' to active suggestion 'we recommend' to satisfy Tone rule
ci-bot: preview run: linkcheck passed; markdownlint passed; vale still complaining: 'we recommend' flagged by Tone as weak phrasing at line 12 (rule prefers direct actionable wording)
zoe: odd; Vale is picky. What's our recommended phrasing?
docs-manager: prefer direct voice like 'Do X to Y' or 'Set the prop to Z'. Replace 'we recommend' with 'Set' or 'Use' where applicable. If it's a suggestion, start with 'Consider'.
mei: changing 'we recommend using' -> 'Use' in the step text. Pushing tiny edit 1782700188 now.
ci-bot: vale passing, all checks green. Requesting review.
docs-manager: quick pass now. small nit: example heading missing H2 underline spacing; fixed inline. Approving for merge.
eng-release: FYI this touches migration guides; is this going into today's doc cut? If yes, tag as pre-cut merge.
zoe: yes please include in today's cut. It's docs-only and fixes broken anchor in the migration guide.
eng-release: fast-track approved for docs-only. No additional signoff required. Merge will follow merge-window rules.
ci-bot: PR #518 merged by docs-bot at 1782700232
alejandro: opened follow-up issue #257 to grep for stale anchors after the component refactor
zoe: note added to the migration checklist. closing thread :white_check_mark:
